info.title: Paradise City location and reviewed landmark contract
info.description: VENU-BE-L01 source contract. Policy is frozen in docs/mcr/contracts/paradise-city-v1/policy-freeze.md. Friend means VENUE_FRIEND_V1: both live follow edges, both current event participants, no live block either way, and an OPEN/LIVE event. Friendship alone grants no location. Missing/stale/invalid authority or policy fails closed (503) with no coordinate. Actual authorities/configuration required; no fabricated runtime defaults or physical acceptance. Independent additive family; does not silently register old operations.

get.description: Only current VENUE_FRIEND_V1 viewers explicitly selected by the owner in an ACTIVE, unexpired sharing lease; bounded50; no raw clusters. Friendship alone grants no coordinate, and an ineligible viewer is omitted even if its ID remains stored. PAUSED/REVOKED/EXPIRED returns no position. Client may cluster only returned authorized locations. No physical projection is inferred.

put.description: Explicit service consent. ACTIVE replaces the selected viewers, each of whom must satisfy VENUE_FRIEND_V1 at the effect, and starts a finite lease of min(now + policy.sharing_lease_ms, policy.valid_until, access deadline). PAUSED/REVOKED require empty viewer_ids, remove all visibility and delete precise fix/check-in in the same transaction. A pause is immediate; a cached or in-flight fix is rejected after the revision changes. Resume requires fresh publication; never starts device GPS.

LandmarkId.description: Opaque reviewed-provider identity. Artwork labels/World IDs never establish authority.

VenueClock.description: Authoritative server clock for the venue. timezone is concert_events.timezone (currently Asia/Seoul only); end_of_day is the next 00:00:00 in that zone strictly after server_time, capped by an earlier approved event cutoff or access deadline. Missing/invalid clock is 503; no browser or device timezone fallback.

timezone.description: concert_events.timezone; the current schema constrains this to Asia/Seoul. Never a client-supplied or device timezone.

end_of_day.description: Next 00:00:00 in timezone strictly after server_time, capped by an earlier approved event cutoff or access deadline. Used unchanged by VENUE_END_DAY notes.

VenueLocationPolicy.description: Source-identified, revisioned, currently valid venue/event policy. No production default exists: missing, stale or invalid policy is 503 before any disclosure. Invariants: 0 < fresh_ms <= last_known_ms <= coordinate_retention_ms; 0 < fix_max_age_ms <= last_known_ms; 0 <= future_skew_ms; 0 < max_accuracy_m; 1 <= max_viewers <= 50.

fresh_ms.description: PHONE freshness. fresh_until = observed_at + fresh_ms. Older than this is LAST_KNOWN (within last_known_ms), never current.

last_known_ms.description: Maximum age at which a PHONE fix may still be returned as LAST_KNOWN. Older values are omitted, not fabricated.

fix_max_age_ms.description: Reject a reported fix older than this at publication. Must be <= last_known_ms.

future_skew_ms.description: Maximum accepted future offset for captured_at; a later sample is invalid input.

sharing_lease_ms.description: ACTIVE sharing lease. expires_at = min(now + sharing_lease_ms, policy.valid_until, access deadline); no default.

request_ttl_ms.description: ASK LOCATION request lifetime: created_at + request_ttl_ms. Repeating a live pair request does not extend it.

check_in_ttl_ms.description: Self-reported check-in lifetime: checked_in_at + check_in_ttl_ms. Check-ins do not become LAST_KNOWN.

coordinate_retention_ms.description: Maximum persistence of a phone fix/check-in after observation. Capped by sharing expiry, event close and account deletion; no movement history.

command_retention_ms.description: L receipt/status metadata retention. Never stores or replays coordinates or request bodies.

max_accuracy_m.description: Reject a reported accuracy above this bound. A device-reported accuracy is not a verified measured accuracy.

max_viewers.description: Maximum explicit viewers per ACTIVE lease; also bounded by the wire's 50. Never expanded automatically.

viewer_ids.description: Explicit selected viewers. Every ID must satisfy VENUE_FRIEND_V1 at the effect; ACTIVE requires 1..max_viewers, PAUSED/REVOKED require an empty array. The list never auto-expands to future friends or followers.

SharingState.description: Owner's current sharing state. OFF is the initial state; ACTIVE ends at expires_at; PAUSED/REVOKED are terminal until a new explicit ACTIVE publication; EXPIRED is derived from now >= expires_at and a read never mutates it.

expires_at.description: ACTIVE lease expiry = min(now + policy.sharing_lease_ms, policy.valid_until, access deadline). Null when not ACTIVE. Never extended by a read, request approval or retry.

VisibleLocation.description: A viewer-specific projection. It is returned only when the owner has an ACTIVE unexpired lease selecting this viewer and the viewer still satisfies VENUE_FRIEND_V1. Friendship alone never produces this object.

source.description: PHONE only while observed_at + policy.fresh_ms has not passed. LAST_KNOWN only within policy.last_known_ms and never labelled current. SELF_REPORTED_CHECK_IN is an assertion, not GPS. UNAVAILABLE carries no position.

fresh_until.description: observed_at + policy.fresh_ms for a PHONE fix; null for check-in/LAST_KNOWN/UNAVAILABLE. A read never extends it.

access_until.description: Earliest current disclosure ceiling: lease, policy, landmark/request expiry and the original access deadline.

physical_arrival_verified.description: Always false. Check-in and invitation acceptance are self-reported and never physical-arrival proof.

access_until.description: Earliest of policy.valid_until, sharing.expires_at, each returned grant/request expiry and the original access deadline.

incoming_requests.description: Current or terminal request metadata between actor and currently returned authorized friends; bounded50, no coordinate disclosure. Sort created_at descending then request_id descending.

outgoing_requests.description: Current or terminal request metadata between actor and currently returned authorized friends; bounded50, no coordinate disclosure. Sort created_at descending then request_id descending.

LocationRequest.description: Metadata for ASK LOCATION between current VENUE_FRIEND_V1 participants. Creating, reading or approving a request never grants a coordinate, device permission or sharing state by itself.

expires_at.description: created_at + policy.request_ttl_ms. A repeated live pair request reuses the row without extending this instant.
